title: Mexican Salad Bowl
description: A flavorful and healthy salad bowl inspired by Mexican cuisine, featuring mixed greens, juicy tomatoes, crunchy tortilla chips, and a zesty dressing.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine mixed greens, diced tomatoes, and crushed tortilla chips.
Top with shredded cheese, sliced avocado, and a dollop of light ranch dressing.
Optional: Add diced chicken or steak for added protein.
Optional: Substitute Greek yogurt for light ranch dressing for a healthier option.
